action: Sculpts the ear close up: strokes along the helix rim and inside the concha to sharpen the ridges, rest of head unpolished behind it with visible stroke streaks.

why: Give the ear crisp rims (helix, antihelix, tragus) so it reads at figure scale.
reader_equivalent: Clay Strips / Draw Sharp to build the rim, Crease along the inner edge, Pinch to tighten.

action: Works the nose bridge and brow area from below and side: nose is a sharp triangular wedge with a soft rounded tip and barely indicated nostrils, scowl folds sculpted between the brows.
tool: sculpt brush on nose bridge (name not readable)
why: Anger expression: vertical and horizontal scowl wrinkles at the glabella while keeping the nose minimal.
reader_equivalent: Crease for the fold lines, Inflate/Blob for the bulges between them, Smooth to soften.

action: Refines forehead, cheek and the open mouth: upper lip as a thick band, separate individually shaped teeth, tongue sculpted out, dark tattoo/brow shapes sit on the surface.
tool: sculpt brushes; dark lines appear as dark-coloured shapes (polypaint or separate mesh, not determinable)
why: Open-mouth grin read: thick lips, teeth row, tongue volume.
reader_equivalent: Clay Strips for lips, Crease to separate teeth, Grab/Inflate for tongue; tattoos via Texture Paint or a separate shrinkwrapped mesh.

action: Close-up of the hair: dozens of separate, curved, pointed locks with crisp edges and a ridge line, layered in overlapping rows; a darker short undercut layer sits underneath.
why: Spiky anime hair as stacked individual locks gives depth and readable silhouette.
reader_equivalent: Separate lock meshes (curve with bevel/taper or ZModeler-like low-poly strips) + Crease/Pinch for the ridge; or Snake Hook on a voxel-remeshed mass.
